pipeline.title: Per-child pipeline
pipeline.note: Each stage runs in its own context. A reviewer that saw the implementer's reasoning is not an independent reviewer.

steps.sees: The verbatim child ticket, agreed seams, pinned base SHA, its own branch and worktree — no sibling diffs.
The ticket and the diff. Never the implementer's transcript, and a new session for every re-review.
The integration worktree it exclusively owns, and the gate output it runs itself.

items.title: Security review added as its own role
items.failure: #44 passed spec review with a missing revoke path — the reviewer read the diff against the ticket, and the ticket was silent.
items.change: A second reviewer at xhigh on any child touching token lifecycle.

items.title: Gate output belongs to the integrator, not the worker
items.failure: #46's first worker claimed the gate passed; the integration worktree disagreed and the agent was killed after a wrong diagnosis.
items.change: Test counts come from a gate the coordinator runs itself, in the worktree it owns.
